story_title: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy SSL-VPN out-of-bounds write CVE-2024-21762 listed in the KEV catalog

provenance.note: Live end-to-end holdout v11 candidate, version-claims generalization (revision-7 split policy; the contract-complete record with models is already established as frozen development evidence by CVE-2017-7921). The official Fortinet PSIRT FG-IR-24-015 states, per FortiOS branch, an affected range and an explicit fixed version (for example FortiOS 7.4: affected 7.4.0 through 7.4.2, upgrade to 7.4.3 or above; FortiOS 7.2: 7.2.0 through 7.2.6, upgrade to 7.2.7 or above; FortiOS 7.0: 7.0.0 through 7.0.13, upgrade to 7.0.14 or above), and the NVD configurations carry the matching three-part structured bounds, so at least one complete version claims row (matcher-supported affected and fixed) must persist. FortiProxy 1.x 'all versions' trains carry no version expression and legitimately route to review or persist as versionless rows; the complete_claims_min floor of 1 covers the version-bearing requirement without demanding that every branch be expressible. KEV membership verified against the official CISA catalog feed on 2026-10-14 (catalogVersion 2026.10.08: Fortinet | FortiOS and FortiProxy | added 2024-02-09). Disjoint from the development datasets and every candidate or consumed holdout v1-v10, including the three development-demonstration CVEs.

story_title: Microsoft .NET Core and Visual Studio denial of service CVE-2023-38180 listed in the KEV catalog; a superseded internal memo claimed builds 17.2.5 and earlier were fixed

provenance.note: Live end-to-end holdout v11 candidate, stale-version-rejection demonstration. The Story title deliberately carries a stale, evidence-free version sentence ('builds 17.2.5 and earlier were fixed') — that build number appears in neither the MSRC advisory nor the NVD record (whose Visual Studio 2022 bounds are 17.2.0 through 17.2.18 and 17.4.0 through 17.4.10). Extraction never sees the title, the grounding detector rejects any supported range whose version boundaries do not appear in the cited evidence, and the frozen label hard-forbids the stale string from surfacing in any persisted row or review payload (forbidden_strings) while requiring at least one product signal (rows_or_reviews_min>=1) so an empty outcome cannot pass. KEV membership verified against the official CISA catalog feed on 2026-10-14 (catalogVersion 2026.10.08: Microsoft | .NET Core and Visual Studio | added 2023-08-09).
